summaryForNext: One adoption (uv to hash-lock dependencies); the rest is built here. Key calls: a small persistent volume for /data, the heartbeat as a second container in the same pod, hosted mode skips the .env check, hosted running-status from the database, migration Job gets its own PreSync ServiceAccount, deploy gated on tests through a reusable workflow, image ID recorded before scans plus a Trivy checksum and failing-scan control, JWKS https except loopback and in-cluster, DNS egress for NodeLocal DNSCache. Open: mail provider, verifier and product (operator inputs).
